title: Pandas for Data Analysis
subtitle: Load, clean, join, aggregate, explore
learningOutcomes: Load any CSV and run the first-look ritual: head, shape, info, describe
Filter, sort and derive columns without writing loops
Clean a genuinely dirty dataset: duplicates, mixed dates, entity variants, contamination
Join tables with merge and choose the join type as an analytical decision
Aggregate with groupby and reshape with pivot_table
Produce the four core market exhibits: price+MAs, return distribution, drawdown, rolling volatility

pages.title: Groupby, Merge and the Join Decision

biasCheck.prompt: 3C demonstrated survivorship in one line and 3D showed a regime change as a picture. Before any analysis on these datasets: which of the four biases applies, and where?

green.prompt: Write pandas code to [task] on a DataFrame with columns [list]. Then explain each line.
This pandas code gives this error: [paste both]. Explain what pandas is complaining about in plain words, then fix it.

red.danger: Trusting generated pandas without a tracer bullet
red.why: AI-generated groupby/merge code is frequently plausible and subtly wrong (wrong join type, silent NaN handling)
red.rule: Verify on a slice you can count by hand before running on the full table
